2.name: WWE EVOLVE: Succession II
2.overview: WWE Evolve kicks off its second season with two championship showdowns. Cappucino Jones gets his chance to unseat Jackson Drake as Evolve Champion.

2.name: March 11, 2026
2.overview: Interim NXT General Manager Robert Stone hosts a town hall to make an important announcement regarding the future of WWE Evolve.

2.name: March 18, 2026
2.overview: Jackson Drake marks his final night in WWE Evolve by defending the WWE Evolve Championship one last time against first-time challenger Aaron Rourke.

2.name: March 25, 2026
2.overview: Aaron Rourke kicks off his WWE Evolve Title reign by hosting a Championship Celebration.

2.name: April 1, 2026
2.overview: Competitors collide in a Fatal 5-Way Match to earn the coveted final entry in the upcoming Womens Evolve Championship Gauntlet Eliminator Match.

2.name: April 8, 2026
2.overview: Aaron Rourke defends the WWE Evolve Title for the first time against one of WWE ID's newest prospects, Chaz "Starboy" Hall.

2.name: April 15, 2026
2.overview: Eight competitors battle in the Eliminator Gauntlet Match to crown a new WWE Evolve Women's Champion.

2.name: April 22, 2026
2.overview: Brooks Jensen has no way to escape from Cappuccino Jones when the rivals are bound together in a Bull Rope Match.

2.name: April 29, 2026
2.overview: Aaron Rourke faces his toughest test to date in a WWE Evolve Championship Triple Threat Match against Braxton Cole and Harlem Lewis.

2.name: May 6, 2026
2.overview: WWE Evolve Champion Aaron Rourke addresses the Evolve Universe following an ambush attempt by Kam Hendrix & Harley Riggins.

2.name: May 13, 2026
2.overview: Karmen Petrovic looks to teach Nikkita Lyons a lesson after she meddled in the Evolve Women's Championship Match.

2.name: May 20, 2026
2.overview: The rivalry between Tate Wilder and Kam Hendrix comes to a head after months of tormenting each other at the WWE Performance Center.

2.name: May 27, 2026
2.overview: Aaron Rourke defends the WWE Evolve Title against Tristan Angels. Timothy Thatcher makes an important announcement regarding WWE Evolve.

2.name: June 3, 2026
2.overview: Tensions rise between The Mog Squad and OG WWE ID competitors as Max Abrams battles Cappuccino Jones. Sloane Jacobs looks to dethrone Wendy Choo.

2.name: June 10, 2026
2.overview: The ongoing issues between The Mog Squad and OG WWE ID competitors come to a head in Six-Man Tag Team Match. Karmen Petrovic duels PJ Vasa.

2.name: June 17, 2026
2.overview: Romeo Moreno recruits Noam Dar as his partner to even the odds against Harley Riggins & Kam Hendrix.

2.name: WWE EVOLVE: Succession III
2.overview: On WWE Evolve's biggest stage, both championships are on the line when Wendy Choo and Aaron Rourke face their toughest challengers yet.

2.name: July 1, 2026
2.overview: The rivalry between OG WWE ID and The Mog Squad escalates with a Six-Man Tag Team Elimination Match. KevOnStage takes on Guest GM duties.

2.name: July 8, 2026
2.overview: Nikkita Lyons begins her reign as WWE Evolve Women's Champion in over-the-top fashion with Big Kat Kita's Championship Celebration.

2.name: July 15, 2026
2.overview: WWE Evolve Champion Aaron Rourke shows his respect for Harlem Lewis by granting the determined challenger an Evolve Championship opportunity.

2.name: July 22, 2026
2.overview: Nikkita Lyons makes her first WWE Evolve Women's Title defense in a throwdown with Laynie Luck. WWE Evolve Champion Harlem Lewis sounds off.

2.name: July 29, 2026
2.overview: NXT standout Tate Wilder returns to WWE Evolve to settle the score with his longtime nemesis Harley Riggins.

2.name: August 5, 2026
2.overview: Harlem Lewis defends the WWE Evolve Title in a Fatal 4-Way Match against Tristan Angels, Max Abrams and Aaron Rourke.

2.name: August 12, 2026
2.overview: Evolve standouts It’s GAL, Cappuccino Jones and Chazz "Starboy" Hall aim to impress in a WWE ID Triple Threat Showcase.

2.name: August 19, 2026
2.overview: Thea Hail puts her devious and dangerous side on full display by challenging Nikkita Lyons for the WWE Evolve Women's Title.

2.name: August 26, 2026
2.overview: Evolve's first Lumberjack Match ensures Brooks Jensen has nowhere to run in his rematch against Elijah Holyfield.

2.name: September 2, 2026
2.overview: New No. 1 Contenders for the Men’s and Women’s Evolve Championships emerge when competitors collide in two Fatal 4-Way Matches.

2.name: September 9, 2026
2.overview: On the WWE ID Showcase Special, the rivalry between WWE ID 1.0 and The Mog Squad culminates with a 4-on-4 Team Gauntlet Series.

2.name: September 16, 2026
2.overview: After emerging victorious in a Fatal 4-Way Match, the undefeated Cutler James earns the right to challenge Harlem Lewis for the Evolve Championship.

2.name: September 23, 2026
2.overview: WWE Evolve celebrates its female competitors, as Nikkita Lyons puts the Evolve Women's Championship on the line against challenger Skylar Raye.

2.name: September 30, 2026
2.overview: Harley Riggins and It's GAL go one-one-one for an opportunity to challenge WWE Evolve Champion Harlem Lewis at Evolve Succession IV.

2.name: October 7, 2026
2.overview: On the eve of Evolve Succession IV, Aaron Rourke looks to teach Kale Dixon a lesson for his meddling in the 4-on-4 Team Gauntlet Series.

2.name: Evolve Succession IV
2.overview: Nikkita Lyons and Harlem Lewis put their respective championships on the line at WWE Evolve's signature showcase.

2.name: October 21, 2026
2.overview: Aaron Rourke gets a rematch against Kale Dixon and looks for payback after Dixon's recent steel chair attack.

overview: A new generation of WWE prospects begin their in-ring journey with the goal of becoming the next great Superstar.
title: WWE EVOLVE
